visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Clean and Reverse Instead of Two Pointers with Regex Tests
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two pointers skip non-letters one step at a time, using a regular expression test on each character. Clean the text once, then compare it with its reverse. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Cleaning first separates "what counts as a letter" from "is it symmetric", and the result reads like the definition of a palindrome.
